scripts.prepare:vendor: node scripts/prepare-vendor.mjs && node scripts/prepare-local-embedding.mjs && node scripts/prepare-local-tts.mjs
scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.main.config.cjs -i assets/css/tailwind.input.css -o assets/generated/tailwind.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.character.config.cjs -i assets/css/tailwind.input.css -o assets/generated/character.css --minify
scripts.build:web: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android-debug.ps1
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-android-release.ps1
